title: VUA packages-ops command v0.2
description: Packages write face, second frozen slice A2 = install/upgrade (proposal 026 face order, core ruling 82a39c4 point 1: upgrade = the same family as install, version-selection semantics land with THIS freeze batch; the v0.1 A1 removal word face stays frozen and served untouched — v0.2 is a separate row directory per the proposal-025 v0.2-increment precedent). Exactly four methods on the packages.* family: the A1 pair (packages.previewRemove / packages.applyRemove, v0.1 shapes verbatim) plus the A2 pair (packages.previewInstall / packages.applyInstall) mapped one-to-one onto the VpmBackend port methods preview_install/apply_install. packages.previewInstall is the SYNCHRONOUS read-only query (a change preview the user confirms; never mutates); packages.applyInstall is the TASK-DRIVEN write command (nine-state task semantics ride the application-contract task surface, not this schema: commandId idempotency, cancellable, events+revision, no implicit resume — honesty rule 3). The A2 preview DOES resolve dependencies against the registered repositories and MAY hit the network: the online repository refresh degrades to the package cache on failure (the ORC-ADP-006 isomorphic precedent) — the preview carries NO cache-sourcing disclosure field (the port ChangePreviewV1 has no carrier; the honesty boundary is documented in the protocol doc, and the double-digest guard stays the safety net); the apply phase's repository load does NOT degrade (an online load failure fails the task honestly). VERSION-SELECTION SEMANTICS (frozen here, the proposal pre-note honored): each packages row is {packageId, version} with version REQUIRED and nullable; version=null = install the version the resolver picks (the port's VersionSelector::latest_for — latest stable, prereleases never auto-selected); version=<string> = pin exactly that version — upgrading AND downgrading use the same pin syntax, an unresolvable pin answers package_not_found, no separate upgrade verb is invented (the port ChangeKindV1 closed set is install|remove and the v0.1 changeItem row already projects both). A repeated packageId across rows is a word-face violation (uniqueItems pins exact duplicates; the closed-list rule text pins the per-id uniqueness — negative vector pins it). Both A2 methods take the SAME registered-path identity as the 013 read face (projectPath); an unregistered path answers the REUSED typed not-found vua.project.project_not_found (same fact, same code, 024 P1 precedent). The confirmedDigest is the FNV-1a digest over the canonical item list that applyInstall binds to — the server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (ORC-WF-003/004; the authoritative verdict lives server-side, proposal-014 arbitration point 2); the backend carries its own second comparison as defense in depth (Fix R2-7: legacy folders count into the digest). packages.previewInstall params carry NO digest slot — a preview request carrying one is a shape violation. Gate: the wire routes for this family do not exist yet (wiring is the next core slice); serving is capability-gated (VpmCapabilities.preview_install — one bit serving both A2 methods, the packages.installOps served-row shape, the A1 removeOps precedent), a backend without the capability answers the generic capability_missing and the honest-absence wire arm vua.packages.unavailable stays for unwired engines.

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity), same fact and code vua.project.project_not_found when unregistered.

packageIds.description: The closed explicit list of package ids to remove. No wildcard, no 'all' shorthand.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest from the previewRemove result the user confirmed. The server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (vua.packages.preview_drift, recoverable — re-preview, never implicit resumption).

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity), same fact and code vua.project.project_not_found when unregistered.

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name). No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

version.description: Version-selection semantics frozen with this batch: null = the resolver picks (latest stable); a string = pin exactly that version (upgrade and downgrade share the pin syntax; an unresolvable pin answers package_not_found).

packages.description: The closed explicit request list. A repeated packageId across rows is a word-face violation even when the versions differ (uniqueItems pins exact duplicates; the closed-list rule text pins the per-id uniqueness; the negative vector pins the rule).
The SAME closed explicit request list the preview answered (the audit link: the confirmed digest binds to exactly that preview's canonical item list).

confirmedDigest.description: The digest from the previewInstall result the user confirmed. The server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (vua.packages.preview_drift, recoverable — re-preview, never implicit resumption).
